findings_qualitative.value: Star-formation tracers explain more of the variance in linewidth normalization than surface density.

evidence.quote: We find that star-formation tracers explain more of the variance in the residuals of the size-linewidth relation than the molecular surface density can due to higher correlation coefficients and lower RMS scatter.

findings_qualitative.value: Excess linewidths are not explained by opacity broadening.

evidence.quote: We do not find evidence that the observed offsets in linewidth from the size-linewidth relation can be explained by broadened linewidths from optically-thick regions.
